mobbin:b5d1550e-5945-48c2-97c4-e12e9ea63.summary: User opens Settings, turns on In-Person Recorder, starts a floating background recording with live waveform, then lands on a Meeting Overview with transcript link, share targets, AI to-do empty state, and short playback.
steps: Toggle In-Person Recorder on + record FAB
steal: Dedicated In-Person Recorder preference toggle (Settings / Toggle on)
Persistent floating recorder (timer, waveform, stop) while navigating Settings (Floating widget / Recording in progress)
Post-session Overview with Transcript chip, Slack/Email/Invite/Notes share row, and Play + See Transcription (Meeting Overview)
To-Do List empty state: 'No actions, you're in the clear!' after AI harvest (Meeting Overview)
avoid: No consent/permission prompt shown when enabling or starting in-person recording — Baseline requires consent for capturing faculty/group speech
mobbin:b5d1550e-5945-48c2-97c4-e12e9ea63.fit: Strong pattern for phone voice-memo fallback beside the debrief room; extends Baseline second-screen capture, but must add consent before record and attach output to the session report.
